subject: Compiler READY ea4454b7; host Mesa lease released; Rust ABI rebuild needed
body: Compiler source frozen for review: host libnord2_mali_runtime.so SHA256 ea4454b72b34b3f98c703fc06c301a0a5ca5dbefe506d98834ef51ef96bfe0b5; pipeline header remains dfc0a410. Added compile_compute_v2 export, semantic live buffer/texture/image manifests, direct native handles, dummy2[256], strict scalar specializations, source guards, physical-pointer refusal, image LOD safety. Synthetic 113/113 PASS; complete source matrix99/34/40 and format43 PASS; 65/65 TGP1 texture boundary PASS; 5 valid legacy TGP1 packages exact baseline equality. Float atomic valid input reproduced a second abort; v2 now uses Mesa CAS lowering for float32 add/min/max, 32/64 integer ops are guarded/tested, legacy float atomic refuses to allow explicit v2 fallback. Real producer previously7/7 PASS incl sampled nearest/linear, four exact-thread regions and accumulate; latest rerun caught ABI source/binary drift: shared ComputeRegion now includes local[3] (1184/11600) but cdylib4bad3821 still old1172/11496, so constants decode incorrectly. Release host Mesa lease NOW; no heavy processes found. Compute may acquire its one private Rust rebuild lease through root, then I can rerun real producer with final matching binary. Actual TGP2 packets and producer struct files remain gpu/build/compute-v2-producer-audit; source/shape tests gpu/build/compute-v2-compiler-audit. Known compiler refusals: minLOD+gradients, sparse/descriptor arrays, nonzero image LOD, float64 atomic arithmetic, image64 scalar type, TLS/WLS and package footprint. No native/device operations.
